house.description: Definition of prior qualified human trafficking-related offense amended to include violations of certain state laws committed in the person's lifetime and violations of similar laws in other states.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; amending the definition of prior qualified human trafficking-related offense to include violations of certain state laws committed in the person's lifetime and violations of similar laws in other states; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.321, subdivision 14.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.321, subdivision 14, is amended to read:

Subd. 14.
Prior qualified human trafficking-related offense.
A "prior qualified human trafficking-related offense" means a [+previous +]conviction or delinquency adjudication [-within the ten years from the discharge from probation or parole immediately preceding the current offense-] for a violation of or an attempt to violate section 609.322, subdivision 1 (solicitation, inducement, and promotion of prostitution; sex trafficking in the first degree); 609.322, subdivision 1a (solicitation, inducement, and promotion of prostitution; sex trafficking in the second degree); 609.282 (labor trafficking); [-or-] 609.283 (unlawful conduct with respect to documents in furtherance of labor or sex trafficking)[+; or a statute from another state or the United States in conformity with any of these offenses+].

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date. +]
